text.tr: Güvenlik duvarı her paket için neye karar verir?
text.en: What does a firewall decide for every packet?

en: Whether it may pass or not
Which language it is written in

explanation.en: According to its rule list.

text.tr: Sıradan bir güvenlik duvarı hangi katmanlarda çalışır?
text.en: Which layers does an ordinary firewall work at?

explanation.en: It looks at address, port and protocol.

text.tr: Bilgisayar (host) güvenlik duvarının ağ güvenlik duvarından farkı nedir?
text.en: How does a host firewall differ from a network firewall?

tr: Her bilgisayarda çalışır, ağın içinden gelen trafiğe de bakar
en: It runs on each computer and also looks at traffic from inside the network
It is used only at home

explanation.en: Both together are defence in depth.

text.tr: Kural listesinde hangi kural kararı verir?
text.en: Which rule in the rule list decides?

en: The first matching rule from top to bottom

explanation.en: The rest are not looked at.

text.tr: Hiçbir kural tutmazsa ne olmalı?
text.en: What should happen if no rule matches?

en: It should be denied by default

explanation.en: Everything not allowed is forbidden.

text.tr: `0.0.0.0/0` ne demektir?
text.en: What does `0.0.0.0/0` mean?

explanation.en: Prefix 0: no network part.

text.tr: Dersteki kurallarda dışarıdan gelen SSH (22) denemesine ne oldu?
text.en: In the lesson's rules, what happened to the SSH (22) attempt from outside?

en: It matched no rule and was refused by the default

explanation.en: SSH was open only to the internal network.

text.tr: Kararı kural numarasıyla kaydetmek neden yararlıdır?
text.en: Why is it useful to log the decision with the rule number?

tr: Bir paketin neden geçtiği ya da durduğu anlaşılır
en: It shows why a packet passed or was stopped

explanation.en: Real firewalls log it too.

text.tr: Gölgelenen (shadowed) kural nedir?
text.en: What is a shadowed rule?

tr: Üstündeki daha geniş bir kural yüzünden hiç çalışmayan kural
en: A rule that never runs because of a broader rule above it
A rule that runs at night

explanation.en: The first matching rule wins.

text.tr: Dersteki `broken` listesinde 23 numaralı port neden açıldı?
text.en: In the lesson's `broken` list, why was port 23 opened?

en: The `any` allow at the top shadowed the `23` deny

explanation.tr: 8080 da açıldı: varsayılan reddetme de devre dışı kaldı.
explanation.en: 8080 opened too: deny by default stopped working as well.

text.tr: Kural listesinde dar ve geniş kurallar nasıl sıralanır?
text.en: How are narrow and broad rules ordered in a rule list?

tr: Dar olanlar üstte, geniş olanlar altta
en: Narrow ones at the top, broad ones at the bottom

explanation.en: Otherwise the narrow rule is shadowed.

text.tr: Durumsuz (stateless) bir süzgeç neden cevaplar için geniş delik açmak zorunda kalır?
text.en: Why does a stateless filter have to open a wide hole for replies?

tr: Hangi paketin bir bağlantının cevabı olduğunu bilemez
en: It cannot know which packet is a reply to a connection

explanation.en: It judges every packet on its own.

text.tr: Durumlu (stateful) güvenlik duvarı dışarıdan gelen paketi ne zaman geçirir?
text.en: When does a stateful firewall let a packet from outside through?

tr: İçeriden başlamış bir bağlantının tersi (cevabı) ise
en: If it is the reverse (reply) of a connection started from inside

explanation.en: It looks at the connection table.

text.tr: Derste aynı sunucudan başka bir porta gelen paket neden durdu?
text.en: In the lesson, why was the packet from the same server to another port stopped?

en: It was not the reverse of a connection in the table

explanation.en: All four fields must match.

text.tr: Çıkış süzmesi (egress filtering) neyi zorlaştırır?
text.en: What does egress filtering make harder?

tr: Ele geçirilmiş bir bilgisayarın dışarıya bağlanmasını

explanation.en: Only the needed ports from inside to outside.

text.tr: Engellenen bir çıkış denemesiyle ne yapılır?
text.en: What is done with a blocked outbound attempt?

tr: Kaydedilir; bir olayın ilk ipucu olabilir
en: It is logged; it can be the first clue of an incident
The computer is wiped at once

explanation.en: It proves nothing on its own.

text.tr: WAF hangi katmanda çalışır?
text.en: Which layer does a WAF work at?

explanation.en: It looks at the content of the HTTP request.

text.tr: WAF neden uygulamadaki açığın yerine geçmez?
text.en: Why does a WAF not replace fixing the hole in the application?

en: It is a list of patterns and can be bypassed

explanation.en: The real defence is in the application's code.

text.tr: 443 portuna izin verilmişse, o porttan gelen SQL enjeksiyonu içeren bir isteği sıradan güvenlik duvarı ne yapar?
text.en: If port 443 is allowed, what does an ordinary firewall do with a request containing SQL injection on that port?

en: Lets it through; it does not look at the content

explanation.en: It cannot see inside allowed traffic.

text.tr: Ağ güvenlik duvarı içeride başlayan bir saldırıyı neden görmez?
text.en: Why does a network firewall not see an attack that starts inside?

en: The traffic does not pass in front of it

explanation.tr: Ağ bölümleme ve bilgisayar güvenlik duvarı gerekir.
explanation.en: Segmentation and host firewalls are needed.

text.tr: SSH portu için doğru kural hangisi?
text.en: Which is the right rule for the SSH port?

tr: Yalnızca yönetim ağına ya da VPN'den gelenlere açık
en: Open only to the management network or those coming over the VPN

explanation.en: Scanners on the internet find it.

text.tr: "Geçici" bir `allow any any` kuralının en büyük tehlikesi nedir?
text.en: What is the biggest danger of a "temporary" `allow any any` rule?

tr: Unutulup yıllarca kalması ve güvenlik duvarını kapatmış olması
en: Being forgotten for years and having switched the firewall off

explanation.en: A temporary rule gets an end date.

text.tr: Adrese dayalı bir kural kimlik doğrulamanın yerini neden tutmaz?
text.en: Why does an address-based rule not replace authentication?

en: The source address can be forged

explanation.en: The Network Attacks section.

text.tr: Kural gözden geçirmede hangisi sorulmaz?
text.en: Which question is not asked in a rule review?

en: How many lines long is the rule list?
Are there rules that never match?

explanation.en: Meaning matters, not length.
